newsitem.title: CHINA: HK Tel local tariffs to rise avg 1.85 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK Tel local tariffs to rise avg 1.85 pct.

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd said on Thursday it would increase local service tariffs by an average of 1.85 percent from August 1.
It said it was lifting charges for 66 local services and products and cutting charges for 53 services and products, while 204 would remain unchanged.
Monthly residential line rentals would increase from HK$67 to HK$68.90, and business lines rentals from HK$104.60 to HK$108.80, Hongkong Telecom said.
It said it would also implement a timed-tariff payphone system from August 1, charging HK$1 for every five minutes.
Hongkong Telecom is a subsidiary of Cable & Wireless Plc, which owns just under 54 percent of the utility.
